title: English Practice Quiz 0641
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.
